name: Gross Distribution Calculator
meta_title: Gross Distribution Calculator: 2026 IRA and 401(k) Tax
meta_description: Find the gross 401(k) or IRA withdrawal you need to keep a set amount after 2026 federal brackets, state tax and any 10% penalty, on top of your other income.
subtitle: Find how much to withdraw from a traditional 401(k) or IRA so you keep the amount you need, with the withdrawal taxed on top of your other 2026 income at the actual federal brackets.

card.fields_html:
Enter the amount you need for 2026

$

The spendable amount you need from a traditional 401(k), 403(b) or IRA this year.

$

Wages, pensions, interest, other withdrawals and the taxable part of Social Security, before the standard deduction. The withdrawal is taxed on top of this income.

%

A flat rate on the withdrawal. Use 0 if your state does not tax retirement withdrawals.

More options
%

Plans withhold 20% on most 401(k) payouts; IRAs default to 10% unless you choose another rate. Withholding changes when you pay, not how much tax you owe.
